description: This file defines the ProductListViewModel class, which manages the list of products with paging support for a Kotlin Android app. It uses Paging library components to load product data efficiently and provides a flow of paged products to the UI.

classes.name: ProductListViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel that provides a paginated list of products to the UI.

methods.name: ProductListViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializes the repository and sets up the flow of paginated product data.
